title: Development and validation of an interpretable machine learning model for the early diagnosis of invasive pulmonary aspergillosis in patients with severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome: a retrospective cohort study.
summary: The study reports a concrete AI-enabled scientific/clinical finding with identifiable cohort or dataset, comparison and quantitative result; this is eligible as an AI-enabled discovery/diagnostic result, with the stated validation limitations.
ai_technology: LASSO/Boruta feature selection and seven ML algorithms directly perform early IPA diagnosis; SHAP interprets features.

evidence.tested: Retrospective cohort model evaluation includes calibration and decision-curve analysis; article explicitly says external validation remains warranted.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO/Boruta feature selection and seven ML algorithms directly perform early IPA diagnosis; SHAP interprets features.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
